name: Ayush Mania
headline: I Own the Part of the System That Is Expensive to Get Wrong
subline: Event ingestion, analytics, money, auth and tenancy, plus the gates and decision records that keep them correct after I move on.
intro: I'm Ayush Mania, a forward deployed engineer and platform architect. I work embedded with product teams to solve problems where they happen - designing systems that help businesses scale without losing reliability. My focus spans backend engineering, cloud infrastructure, and applied LLM systems: semantic search, agentic workflows, and the unglamorous plumbing that keeps them honest in production. I turn complex problems into simple, efficient solutions that ship.

education.degree: Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering
